description: Deny -> recovery matrix. Every denial cause the system can produce maps to: the public behavior (always opaque, always with a continuation pointer per C3), the recovery path the user can take, the certification requirement it satisfies, and the test that exercises it. Single source of truth for docs/certification.md.

rows.public_behavior: opaque accept-shape with continuation pointer; no reason exposed
rows.recovery_path: Re-issue the request with a valid ISO date; request_key is retry-stable so a corrected retry dedupes cleanly.
rows.requirement: no dead ends: malformed input yields a defined next action, not silence

rows.public_behavior: opaque accept-shape with continuation pointer; no reason exposed
rows.recovery_path: Re-issue with an IANA timezone; the personal surface lists valid zones.
rows.requirement: useful failure recovery: the failure is recoverable without revealing system internals

rows.recovery_path: Client regenerates a 16-128 char request key and retries; documented in the integration contract.

rows.public_behavior: opaque accept-shape; indistinguishable from any other invalid request (C2)
rows.recovery_path: Client uses a fresh request key; conflicting reuse never silently overwrites the earlier request.
rows.requirement: no silent failures: dedupe conflicts are rejected loudly to the control plane, opaquely to the caller

rows.public_behavior: opaque accept-shape with continuation pointer; unknown vs forbidden indistinguishable
rows.recovery_path: Re-run prepare_day_brief to obtain a fresh reference; references expire and are never bearer credentials.
rows.requirement: no dead ends; no existence oracle

rows.recovery_path: Start a new request; canceled tasks are never silently resurrected.

rows.public_behavior: opaque accept-shape with continuation pointer; audience-sensitive content never prepared
rows.recovery_path: Use the controlled host for audience-sensitive briefings, or accept the durable-public projection.
rows.requirement: no silent failures: the profile downgrade is audited control-plane-side

rows.recovery_path: Continue on the personal device; the task state is preserved and nothing needs re-entering.
rows.requirement: no dead ends: denial preserves task utility via the personal continuation

rows.public_behavior: opaque accept-shape with continuation pointer; stale lease never honored
rows.recovery_path: The renderer stops the segment; the owner continues privately from the preserved task state.
rows.requirement: useful failure recovery: mid-render audience change stops output AND keeps the task

rows.recovery_path: Request a fresh lease via a new tool call; expiry is expected, not an error the user caused.

rows.public_behavior: opaque accept-shape; identical to unknown-ref (no oracle)
rows.recovery_path: Authenticate on the personal surface, then redeem the reference from the inbox.

rows.public_behavior: opaque accept-shape; identical to unknown-ref (no oracle)
rows.recovery_path: Start a new request; revocation is owner-intended and final.
rows.requirement: no dead ends; revocation is a terminal state with a defined next step

rows.public_behavior: opaque accept-shape; internal validation failure never surfaces detail
rows.recovery_path: Control-plane alert; the user retries the request. No user action could have avoided it, so no user-facing instruction is needed beyond retry.
rows.requirement: no silent failures: internal faults are audited, retried requests get fresh receipts

rows.public_behavior: opaque acknowledged-shape; unknown vs forbidden indistinguishable
rows.recovery_path: None needed: there is nothing to withdraw. The acknowledgement shape is identical so callers cannot probe.

rows.public_behavior: state=canceled; pending work and unreleased grants canceled
rows.recovery_path: None needed; cancellation confirmed. A new request starts fresh work.
rows.requirement: useful failure recovery: cancellation is confirmed, not assumed

rows.recovery_path: Exact completion state is shown privately after reconciliation; the owner sees what actually happened before any retry.
rows.requirement: accurate status: cancellation is distinguished from undo; no false completion

rows.public_behavior: audience degrades to UNKNOWN; audience-sensitive content withheld with continuation pointer
rows.recovery_path: Restore the sensor heartbeat or continue on the personal device; the system never upgrades disclosure on missing evidence.
rows.requirement: fail closed; no silent failures: the disconnect is audited and surfaced as degraded capability

rows.public_behavior: audience degrades to UNKNOWN; audience-sensitive content withheld with continuation pointer
rows.recovery_path: Fresh observation re-establishes the audience; until then, personal continuation.
